title: Juicy Jumbled Vietnamese Pork Bun-Rieu
description: A comforting Vietnamese soup made with a rich pork broth, tender pork meatballs, and a variety of crunchy toppings, perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: In a large wok or pot, heat the oil over medium heat and sauté the onion until softened.
Add the garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the pork bones and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the tomato paste, fish sauce, and 4 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
While the soup is cooking, prepare the meatballs by mixing the ground pork with a little water and forming into small balls.
Add the meatballs to the soup and cook for another 5 minutes.
Stir in the almonds and bitter melon, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.
